localExtensions.tasks.ts: Unified local task browser; synchronous event-bus adapters in versioned manager patches; no model calls.
localExtensions.ui-polish.ts: House style for all short menus: shared title/hint/focus helpers, Pi 1.5.0 native selectors restyled (❯ marker, grey rules, keyHint rows, sentence-case titles), non-exported screens patched on first show, compact interactive-shell messages; native handlers, row counts and child indices preserved; restored on shutdown.

localChanges.files.ts: Alt+O shortcut; house-style title/hints via ui-polish helpers and Pi's select-list theme; search focus propagated for IME.
